verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural faults: the orange divider has moved below the body copy instead of separating it from the headline, there is a big dead gap between the headline and the body, and the legal line is unreadably small. A is worse because everything has shrunk: the eyebrow and body copy are tiny, and the CTA button and its label look weak for a 432px-wide canvas. B keeps the eyebrow, headline, body and CTA at sizes you can read with proper hierarchy, though its body copy runs close to the side margins.
